as_told.title: Buzz Aldrin's Apollo 11 object following the spacecraft

plain: Something is said to have followed the Apollo 11 astronauts on their way to the Moon in 1969. The UFO investigator James Fox heard it from Fay Ann Potter, the sister of the astronaut Buzz Aldrin, and says Aldrin had told her "they were followed by something to the Moon." On a later episode Fox tells it a little differently, saying Potter told him Aldrin had "some UFO encounter on the way to the moon," which makes it Aldrin's own experience. Michels tells it in his own words without a family source, saying Aldrin openly admitted "in multiple interviews" that something was following them. If true, it would mean the first crew to land on the Moon met something they could not identify along the way.
